Subject: DPIA evidence handoff — Article 30 ledger and ops logs

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on — Novamed is preparing a DPIA update for our regulator review next month and we need a short pack from Redwood covering:

- Article 30 processing register extract that shows processing activities for Novamed accounts (sample or full extract)
- Recent access logs (7-day sample) for audit sampling
- Confirmation of subprocessor roster and the dates they were onboarded for Novamed-specific flows
- Any DPIA-support matrix you maintain (mapping controls to risks)

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Ideally we need something we can present by 2027-04-11. If there are any NDAs or redaction limits, flag them so our legal team can decide.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — regulator is on a tight schedule.

Best,
Marta López
Privacy Lead — Novamed Health
M: +44 7700 111222

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and proposed next steps: 

1) Article 30 register extract: we can provide a CSV export filtered to Novamed's tenant/processing activities (includes processing purpose, categories of data, transfers, and legal basis). Estimate delivery: 2027-04-02 EOD.

2) Access logs sample (7 days): we can deliver a zipped sample of logs with IPs redacted per our standard practice. Estimate delivery: 2027-04-02 EOD.

3) Subprocessor roster: we have a current public roster plus an internal onboarding timeline (dates + contracts). We will include a short memo clarifying which subprocessors handle Novamed traffic. Delivery: 2027-04-02.

4) DPIA-support matrix: Marissa will attach the mapping (controls -> evidence artifacts) and highlight any items that require additional attestation.

Are there any specific format constraints your regulator prefers (CSV vs Excel vs PDF)? We'll put a Drive bundle together and can also provide a downloadable zip for your legal team.

Soojin — can you prepare the matrix and the art30 extract? Marissa — can you confirm any attestation language we should include?

Thanks — Jonas
Director, Trust & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Hi Marta / team,

Attaching what we can share immediately and summarising the handoff plan below. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDrive (Novamed evidence bundle). Doc names inside: art30-ledger-extract-20270331.csv, access-logs-sample-7days.zip, dpia-support-checklist-jonas.xlsx

What we're attaching now (preview stubs included in the Drive):
- art30-ledger-extract-20270331.csv (CSV export; contains processing activity rows filtered to Novamed tenant).
- access-logs-sample-7days.zip (7-day sample; IPs redacted; event timestamps preserved).
- dpia-support-checklist-jonas.xlsx (matrix mapping control IDs to evidence artifacts and where to find them).

Handoff timeline / MAP suggestion:
- 2027-04-02: Full artifact bundle delivered to Drive + zip.
- 2027-04-04: Novamed legal/tech Q&A window (48 hours).
- 2027-04-06: Redwood to provide clarifications / minor extracts (if requested).

A couple of notes / limits:
- The CSV contains internal object IDs we cannot expose in raw form; we've included pseudonymized IDs and a mapping key in the Drive (sufficient for audit tracing).
- We will not provide full unredacted IP addresses; our standard practice redacts to /24. If regulator requires full IPs under an executed DPA amendment or court order, we will need a narrow data request and NDAs.

If Novamed needs a signed attestation for specific controls (SOC-2 mapped attestations), let us know which control IDs and we'll route to compliance for an attestation letter (this may take 3–5 business days).

2) Schedule walkthrough: 2027-04-05 at 09:00 UTC — please confirm or propose alternate times.
3) Attestation request: Novamed to confirm final control IDs in the Drive; Redwood to confirm feasibility and cadence for attestation.

We appreciate the quick turnaround. Once the DPA amendment is in place we can close this DPIA item with the regulator.

Best regards,
Marta López
